| [AM.MAN.DEX.POLICY.LEARNING.16] <a id="am-man-dex-policy-learning-16"></a> | **AdvDex / OmniShare｜Human visual–tactile dataset · Synchronized action–touch collection · Contact-constrained retargeting**<br>[AdvDex: Learning Dexterous Manipulation from Human Demonstrations via Joint-Aligned Actions and Adversarial Learning](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2608.14028v1)<br>Zhiyue Zhao, Jingyi Wu, Hairuo Liu, Mingyu Liu, Liyang Li, Hengdi Zhang, Tong He, Zhengxue Cheng<br>[Canonical paper entry](../policies/policy-learning.md#am-man-dex-policy-learning-16)<br>**Tags:** `dexterous` [vla](../../../topics/vla.md) `human-demonstrations` `cross-embodiment` `joint-aligned-action-space` `domain-adversarial-learning` `gradient-reversal` `diffusion-action-expert` `imitation-learning` [tactile](../../../topics/tactile.md) `human-visuo-tactile-dataset` `tactile-data-collection` `synchronized-motion-touch` `contact-constrained-retargeting` `human-to-robot-transfer` `real-world` | OmniShare synchronizes human-hand motion, multi-view video and normal contact force, combining kinematic and tactile constraints during hand retargeting to build human visual–tactile demonstrations for AdvDex's cross-embodiment action learning.<br>**Evaluation scope:** The model and OmniShare contributions share one record. The tactile entry concerns real data acquisition, not model-synthesized observations. Table 1 lists 168k trajectories, 14 views and 721 objects; the text reports over 500 tasks. The glove combines 29 magnetic encoders with a Hall-effect tactile array for hand motion and normal contact force. ArUco/FoundationPose estimate wrist/object poses; kinematic and tactile discrepancies jointly guide MANO retargeting before JAAS mapping. Touch is used in collection and processing; the paper does not describe tactile input to the deployed policy. JAAS functionally aligns SE(3) wrist poses and 15 canonical finger-joint slots across human hands, DexH13 and grippers, masking unavailable slots in the action loss; 15 slots must not be equated with 15 scalar DoF. A VLM encodes a single-view image/instruction; the DiT combines its feature with the current kinematic state to denoise action chunks. A discriminator reads features/state, with reversed gradients applied to the VLM only during training. OmniShare, VITRA-1M and OXE are mixed 5:4:1 for pretraining before target-robot adaptation. Real-robot evaluation uses Paxini Tora with 19-DoF DexH13 hands, 1,000 robot demonstrations across five tasks and 20 trials per method/task. Grippers participate in the shared representation/training data, but real-gripper and multi-dexterous-hand transfer comparisons are not established. Zero-shot skill transfer still co-trains on 1,000 other-task robot trajectories and 1,000 human trajectories, with target skills present only in human data; it is not robot-data-free learning. Downloadable code, datasets and checkpoints have not been verified. | arXiv v1 / 2026 | [Paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2608.14028v1) | Initial reading<br>2026-11-04 |
